question: Should this repository grant the workflow—hard-bound to vincentkoc—the authority to reconcile the crawl-remote Cloudflare Access application and publish generation-bound credentials across openclaw/clawsweeper and openclaw/gitcrawl-store?
rationale: Automated tests can validate fail-closed mechanics, but they cannot authorize the permanent operator identity, Cloudflare mutation scope, cross-repository secret-writing scope, or operational recovery ownership.

options.title: Approve the exact authority
options.body: Accept the named operator and repository scopes after reviewing redacted staged create, rotate, and resume evidence.

options.title: Use a shared authorization gate
options.body: Replace the single-person binding with a protected environment or another maintainer-approved team-controlled authorization model.

options.title: Keep provisioning external
options.body: Decline repository-owned credential bootstrap and retain manually controlled out-of-repository provisioning.

recommendation.title: Approve the exact authority
recommendation.body: Accept the named operator and repository scopes after reviewing redacted staged create, rotate, and resume evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the proposed implementation and is the exact runtime identity authorized by the workflow, making them the best available owner for presenting and clarifying the boundary.
